mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_balances WHERE period = #{period} ORDER BY account_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_balances WHERE period = #{period}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(closing_debit), 0) FROM account_balances WHERE period = #{period}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(closing_credit), 0) FROM account_balances WHERE period = #{period}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_balances (batch_id, period, account_code, account_name, opening_debit, opening_credit, period_debit, period_credit, closing_debit, closing_credit, partner_code) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{period}, #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, COALESCE(#{openingDebit},0), COALESCE(#{openingCredit},0), COALESCE(#{periodDebit},0), COALESCE(#{periodCredit},0), COALESCE(#{closingDebit},0), COALESCE(#{closingCredit},0), #{partnerCode})

INSERT INTO account_balances (batch_id, period, account_code, account_name, opening_debit, opening_credit, period_debit, period_credit, closing_debit, closing_credit, partner_code) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.period}, #{item.accountCode}, #{item.accountName}, COALESCE(#{item.openingDebit},0), COALESCE(#{item.openingCredit},0), COALESCE(#{item.periodDebit},0), COALESCE(#{item.periodCredit},0), COALESCE(#{item.closingDebit},0), COALESCE(#{item.closingCredit},0), #{item.partnerCode})
